summary: Added internal/fence, a pure judge (splitter, wrapper unwrapping, fence and Copilot-stem matching, path rules), and `vloop fence check` on top of it.
verified: vloop task gate T1 exited 0 and printed gate T1: ok; go test ./..., go vet, gofmt, go mod tidy -diff and linux/windows builds are clean.
notes: fence.New(phase, root, home) reads fence/review.json (the Bash deny bodies) and driver.CopilotDenyStems() (new export of the shell(...) stems in Fence matching form); T2 should call Judge.Decide(tool, path, command). For apply_patch the patch text goes in the command argument. Beyond the contract, the judge also denies (fail closed): subshell parens, shell keywords as a command word (if/for/while/{ ...), and sh/bash/... with no -c string (script or stdin). Under `go test ./...` a VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 inherited from a loop session makes the task_gate tests fail; unset it to run them.
